verdict.rationale: Factory provides real-time visibility into agent activity via Software Factory's automation coverage map, live mission monitoring with worker progress and execution logs, and session filtering/status across projects; the CLI also shows proposed diffs before applying. However, there's no explicit evidence of a granular 'live streaming' view of a single running agent's step-by-step actions with fine-grained status updates comparable to a dedicated observability dashboard. Missing for 10: hands-on/independent confirmation of real-time step-level agent action streaming, and detail on latency/granularity of status updates.
